meta.description: Formulate evidence-bounded scientific questions, candidate hypotheses, rival explanations, causal or associational claims, discriminating predictions, measurements, and preregistration-ready analysis plans. Use when turning observations or preliminary findings into transparent, testable research plans without treating hypotheses as facts.

scientific_integrity.detail: Exceptional scientific integrity: never presents hypotheses as facts, requires evidence traceability, prevents HARKing, enforces distinction between observation and inference

practice_boundaries.detail: Appropriate scope with clear non-negotiable boundaries: no clinical diagnosis, no bypassing oversight, no fabrication, no automatic scoring

methodological_ground.detail: Based on established research methodology: strong inference, causal inference frameworks, preregistration, PICO/PECO frameworks, and current reporting guidelines

code_usability.detail: 7 bundled deterministic, local-only CLIs that validate declarations and internal consistency without scoring or executing text from inputs

functional_suitability.note: Comprehensive 12-step workflow from scope/safety to human accountability; 7 bundled CLIs with complete schemas; excellent 9-reference progressive disclosure

reliability.note: Perfect: Python 3.11+ standard library only, deterministic and local-only CLIs, no network/credentials/models/external packages, bounded JSON/CSV/Markdown inputs

performance_context.note: Well-organized 265-line SKILL.md with exceptional progressive disclosure through 9 detailed reference files; clear workflow structure

agent_usability.note: Perfect trigger description with specific use-case patterns; clear scope boundaries and non-negotiable safety gates; explicit object distinctions table

human_usability.note: Excellent: no installation required (standard library), clear workflow steps, templates for all major artifacts, and comprehensive safety guidance

security.note: Perfect: non-negotiable safety boundaries, sensitive data authorization required, no external transmission without approval, fabrication prevention, oversight enforcement

maintainability.note: Excellent with version 2.1, last-reviewed date (2026-07-23), license, compatibility; dated source ledger verified through 2026-07-23; minor: no explicit changelog

agent_specific.note: Strong composability with clear input/output contracts for 7 CLIs; excellent progressive disclosure with 9 references; minor: workflow orchestration could show multi-tool sequences
